01

Are these your questions?

  1. Which words do our customers use to talk about us?
  2. Are our claims repeated, or do they stay in our presentations?
  3. Which proofs make a message credible in our category?
  4. How do our competitors hold the ground?
02

What it pays back

  1. 01Messages that land

    Your messaging uses the words your customers already use.

  2. 02Fewer rounds with the agency

A fixed monthly fee, no commitment, with unlimited studies inside it.

03

A typical case

Illustrative example

The context
A carmaker highlights its EV's acceleration.
What the conversation showed
Its customers mostly talk about silence, boot space and running costs.

Our recommendation

Rewrite the family messaging around those three words.

They talk about it“The internet, to capture the consumer's voice.”L'Oréal · C. Besson · 51:29
04

Our approach to this case

We set your brand platform against the real conversation of your category. We rank words, claims and proofs by traction, for you and your competitors, to see which ones travel and which ones stay in your presentations.

  1. 1Framing

    We start from your brand platform and current messages.

  2. 2Collection

    We collect the conversation of your category and competitors.

  3. 3Analysis

    An analyst ranks words and proofs by traction.

  4. 4Decision

    We propose a vocabulary to adopt, and one to drop.

What we read

  • Customer conversationThe words people use spontaneously about the category.
  • SearchThe questions people actually ask.
  • CompetitorsTheir messages and what the public picks up.
  • Generative AIThe terms assistants associate with your brand.
05

Frequently asked questions

Do you work with our agency?

Yes: we give them the material, they write. It is often the best pairing.

Can a message be tested before launch?

We can measure its chances: do its words and proofs match those already travelling?

How long does it take?

A few days for a first read, two to three weeks for a full piece of work.
